content: We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below, reproduces the reaction: TMSOTf protecting alcohols. We have input from previous step: molecule SMILES and template_id 1914390. That template presumably is the retrosynthetic template for protecting alcohol with TMSOTf. We need to get the mapped_rxn for that template. Use get_template with template_id 1914390.
